points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e185a0a clean build succeeded in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs,3 GiB,256 pids) with explicit library/header roots; compiler warnings include unchecked fread results.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: State/time/step restart exists, but driver.cpp:1044–1045 initializes previous BDF state from loaded current state, preventing uninterrupted two-level transient continuation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct mesh, flux, gradients, residual, partition, halo and output modules; driver.cpp remains monolithic.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No copied core identified in inspected source; no exhaustive external similarity search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case configuration supplies input path; mesh.cpp:164 assumes HDF5 /Base layout, a generality limitation distinct from two-filename dispatch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only global mesh, METIS and neighbor halos exist; failed Re20 rank-study drag anomaly is unbound to same binary.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Roe fallback and positivity/rollback paths exist, but seven production attempts explicitly fail; restart reader has unchecked fread warnings.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build succeeded; CTest reports no registered tests. Existing standalone probes were not independently executed and no CFD rerun occurred.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Checkpoint 18e70a9 contains no tracked solver/build paths and preserves result evidence; manager curation is not contestant misconduct.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: flux.cpp and residual.cpp implement 2-D compressible inviscid and viscous flux paths; seven selected cases fail.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:158–176 uses /Base HDF5 layout, discovers zones and handles supported separate element sections; general CGNS names/types are limited.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: residual.cpp uses face fluxes and boundary paths; selected case failures and partition-boundary ghost reconstruction limit confidence.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.cpp:39–42,76 implements Roe with Rusanov fallback; failed cases limit production credibility.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: residual.cpp handles wall/farfield fluxes; output.cpp:69–72 writes zero no-slip wall velocities.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: grad.cpp:9–14 computes owned-cell least-squares gradients; residual.cpp:16–21 uses unreconstructed ghost state at partition boundaries.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: grad.cpp:81–125 applies Barth-style limiting and positivity checks on owned reconstructed states; ghost side remains first order.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: forces.cpp:24–37 projects tangential shear, and residual.cpp:57–67 evaluates wall viscous stress. All selected laminar/cylinder results are failed.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp implements iterative steady solve and rollback, but six selected steady cases fail and one converges; individual histories documented.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:1094–1112 freezes BDF anchor and records actual outcomes; selected Re200 is failed at t30 with 3000 target misses and max3142 reported inner evaluations.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only setup, METIS and neighbor halos are implemented. Re20 np1/np2 Cd differs by2.0667 at step300 with identical case JSON and same logged initialization; runs fail and bracket a source fix with unknown binary revisions, so DQ4 rank-only causation is unproven.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: One selected case passes the final-status requirement; seven are honestly completed=false/failed. Required artifacts remain in checkpoint.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Read-only examiner validator passes M200 inviscid and report and rejects seven selected failed packages because metadata completed=false.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Only M200 inviscid reaches reported residual target; seven runs are explicitly failed, including Re200 at t30/300.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M200 inviscid Cd≈0.0931 is plausible with force variation; failed cases show large lift, negative or frozen drag, or incomplete transient.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted checkpoint-matched 50-page report has actual case histories and contours; the prior missing-plot claim was false. Some plots are small and partial results remain clearly identified.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report documents seven failures and partial Re200 FFT; references and actual figures are present. Historic source revision unknown and rank-study binary binding unresolved.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report PDF and selected case histories match checkpoint 18e70a9; source revision is unknown and Re20 rank study spans an intervening source fix.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable e185a0a clean build passed in restricted network-disabled cfd-bench. State/time/step restart exists, but driver.cpp:1044–1045 initializes the prior BDF state from the loaded current state, so uninterrupted two-level transient restart is not preserved.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:158–176 assumes HDF5 /Base layout, reads separate supported elements and discovers multiple zones; unsupported section types are skipped. Geometry/partition paths exist but general CGNS coverage is limited.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: residual.cpp constructs face fluxes and characteristic/wall paths; seven selected runs fail and positivity/rollback behavior limits numerical confidence.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: grad.cpp:9–14,97–125 computes owned-cell least-squares gradients and Barth-style limiter; residual.cpp:16–21 uses unreconstructed ghost state at partition boundaries. Rank-boundary accuracy is limited; active reconstruction exists elsewhere.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: forces.cpp:24–37 projects tangential wall shear; residual.cpp:57–67 uses wall gradients and viscous stress. Selected viscous cases fail, but this is not a full-traction mislabel.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: driver.cpp:1094–1112 forms frozen BDF2 anchor and :1630–1634 records inner outcomes; selected Re200 is honestly failed at t30 with 3000/3000 misses and metadata max3142 inner evaluations against configured1000. Exact production binary revision is unknown.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: main.cpp:102–112 builds global mesh on root, partition.cpp:355 calls METIS, halo.cpp:23–33 exchanges neighbors. Re20 np1/np2 step300 Cd differs by2.0667 but failed runs bracket a source fix and unknown binary revisions prevent DQ4 causation.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: One M200 inviscid case reaches target with readable plots; seven selected cases are explicitly failed. Per-case force histories and partial Re200 analysis are documented.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Accepted 50-page report includes case plots, force tables and detailed failure disclosure; production result figures are omitted from curated tip, limiting clean rebuild. Re200 St0.1333 is a disclosed t30 partial result, not a finished shedding claim.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate mesh, flux, gradient, residual, partition, halo and output modules exist, but state and geometry are 2-D and driver.cpp is monolithic; 3-D/general-physics extensibility is limited.

flags.evidence: No affirmative false-success evidence: One production case reaches its residual target; seven are honestly failed and the explicit final validator rejects incomplete metadata.
No internal existing CFD solver executable call found in inspected source; no exhaustive external authorship search.
No direct evidence that forces/residuals were generated without solving; an exactly constant failed M0.8 laminar tail is not proof of synthesis.
Case-driven CGNS mesh input is not limited to two hard-coded filenames.

Re20 np1/np2 step300 Cd1.615080/−0.451645 differ by 2.066725 with identical case JSON, but both runs failed and have unknown revisions; source fix 4722f3a occurred between runs, so rank-only causation and same-binary controls are unproven.
Source contains implicit and BDF2 paths; explicit-only integration not established.
Major report-described methods have inspected source counterparts; incorrect physical results and incomplete restart are separately scored.
No specific report figure proven unrelated to its submitted data; accepted PDF and checkpoint figures have qualified historical provenance.
Root-only full mesh setup, METIS and neighbor halo/local state paths exist; all-rank full-state/geometric-only condition not established.
Owned reconstruction is active; ghost-side first-order handling and unbound historic binary limit accuracy but do not prove globally disabled production reconstruction.
Surface writer emits no-slip boundary values; undocumented adjacent-cell wall-velocity failure not established.
No specific report figure variable-name swap established.
No affirmative copied/wrapped open-source CFD core found in inspected source; no exhaustive external authorship search.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
All ten sections, eight cases, 27 review points and 13 DQ rules assessed to available evidence. Historic binary and rank-study attribution remain unbound; no CFD/Re200 rerun.
